note: Generated by XDrishti.Application.Tests LiveGoldenTests from the real server calculators; never edit by hand (XD_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 dotnet test --solution XDrishti.slnx -c Release rewrites it). Money and percentages are rounded to 4 decimals, halves away from zero, as the API does; every xirr and every income.netXirr is null (not recomputed by the browser). Schema 2 adds the dividends and costs recorded for each case (income) and the income object of rows, tiles, groups and totals; an Unallocated group (key ~unallocated) holds what belongs to no group. Schema 3 adds income.ledgerCharges (the ledger part of income.charges; null below account level), income.tradeChargesFrom and income.ledgerChargesFrom, and income.coverageFrom becomes the LATER start of the sources that exist (income.chargesFrom the later of the two charge sources).

scenarios.name: sources-and-close-days
scenarios.description: Holdings priced by a sync, a quote and a live tick, with the previous close of the same day, of yesterday, of unknown day and none; partly and fully closed holdings; an unpriced and an unmapped one; a broker quantity that differs from the open lots'; one instrument in two accounts in different states; sub-paise prices; an older push that is ignored. Dividends of holdings (also of a closed and of an unpriced one), unallocated dividends, an account with nothing but an unallocated dividend and ledger costs, trade charges (also of a security no holding has), ledger costs with a refund, and accounts with and without a ledger.

scenarios.name: push-ordering
scenarios.description: Older, equal and late pushes: only a newer price time, or the same time with another price, replaces. Two equal dividends (two genuine payments) and a trade charge: the income does not move with a push, its total return does.

scenarios.name: unpriced-and-unmapped
scenarios.description: Groups made only of unpriced holdings (no value, not zero; their dividends and costs still count, their returns are unknown), a mixed group, a zero previous close, an unmapped holding and a closed one.

scenarios.name: no-previous-close-anywhere
scenarios.description: No holding has a previous close: the day change stays unavailable, every open holding is counted as excluded.

scenarios.name: many-rows-sub-paise
scenarios.description: 150 holdings of 45 instruments in 4 accounts and 3 buckets, prices to four decimals, so sums of rounded rows and rounded sums can differ.
